evidence.source: REM-58 gate locked the panel conditional-polling / transport / draft-safety contract. loadTransportFileP now classifies 429 (rate limit) distinctly from a generic transport error (rateLimited=true, transport rate_limited) so a rate-limited observer read is not mislabeled as a generic 5xx; the new panelInteractionActiveP() render gate extends applyPollRenderP deferral beyond text input to an open drawer (D4_DRAWER_RETURN_ID / UI.d4SelectedModule), an active filter (UI.eventFilter / UI.motivationFilter), a non-today selected date (UI.selectedDate !== today()) and an expanded card (UI.expandedCards) — data is still fetched, only the render is queued (panelDraftActiveP stays the fetch-skip gate, panelInteractionActiveP is the render gate).
